name: NeRF-style Volume Rendering Integrator
definition: A simplified NeRF-style integrator that accumulates emission along a ray through a medium, backed by a dense grid instead of a neural network, with no direction-dependent emission.
summary: The NeRF-style Volume Rendering Integrator computes ray color by accumulating emission weighted by transmittance using a fixed-step marching loop over a dense grid, distinguishing itself from alpha compositing by avoiding adaptive sampling and direction-dependent emission.
